title: AC1024 physical MLINESTYLE sentinel output and readback

source.name: STANDARD
source.fixturePolicy: Reused the existing local DWG witness; no DWG or DXF fixture was added.

implementation.change: Added a focused physical-source output/readback selector for the admitted AC1024 MLINESTYLE built-in BYLAYER sentinel profile.

outputReadback.route: Full physical source export in explicit partial-read mode, followed by fresh dx_iface import of each exact output file.
checked: one output style at the source handle and name
parent, flags, description, fill color and cap angles
two ordered elements with matching offset and color
each source linetype index 32767 is emitted and read back as BYLAYER with no linetype handle

failureAndRetry.negativeControl: Change the first source linetype index to unsupported value 7; export refuses and preserves a pre-existing destination sentinel.
failureAndRetry.retry: Restore the source value and retry on the same adapter; ASCII and Binary export and freshly reimport successfully.

focusedSelector.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary; both report STANDARD identity, two BYLAYER sentinel elements, atomic refusal and same-adapter retry.

validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; focused physical selector and warning-as-error target build were sufficient for this profile slice.

limitations: Export uses AllowPartial; the global strict-complete gate remains closed by 228 opaque callback views and zero retained correlation frames.
This closes only the physical STANDARD style and its two BYLAYER sentinel elements; ordinary unbound linetype indices and other MLINESTYLE source profiles remain refused.
Fresh libdxfrw readback is transport evidence, not independent CAD consumer, native-platform or rendering qualification.
No support claim or external item is promoted.

planImpact.completedActionRemoved: Bind physical AC1024 MLINESTYLE handle 0x18 and its two built-in BYLAYER elements to ASCII/Binary output and fresh readback with atomic refusal and corrected retry.
planImpact.nextAction: Close the five P5-owned physical census profiles, then rerun the composed strict gate without relaxing the callback/correlation predicate.
